Expanded runtime qualification from the previous lifecycle checklist to cover durable intent, forced missing-alarm recovery, delayed/sleep catch-up, synchronous listener registration, Opera GX target-browser compatibility, and sub-floor interval truthfulness.
Expanded troubleshooting and external platform references while keeping target-browser runtime proof fail-closed.
